blocks.place: the Route 1 mansion: the house's old ward, cracked in the landing floor (tools/route1_mansion.py WARD_STONE)
blocks.why: One block, not a lattice, so no seam inside the house falls back to the forest pool. Range 18 from the landing floor (between the storeys) reaches every standable floor cell of the house as a sphere or a column: the farthest interior corner is 15.1 blocks away horizontally and 5 below, 15.9 in all (EXP-021 measured the horizontal edge at the configured range; the vertical shape is EXP-033, unrun). Its edge falls inside the forest clearing (radius 22 round (1630, 5034), tools/maze_forest.py), so the ghosts keep to the house and its grounds and nothing reaches Route 1, 160 blocks away; no other block is within 36, so no ranges overlap.

blocks.place: the world-tree sapling in Route 1's maze forest: inside its trunk, below the crown
blocks.why: One block inside the trunk (hidden, and never broken by a player walking the clearing), 8 above the crown's lowest limbs and below its top: the prefab's branch floor is y139-143 and its crown y151-163 (kits/structures/prefabs/trees/tree_town/sapling_oak_a.json habitat, placed at y123 by tools/maze_forest.py). Range 14 reaches the crown radius (12) horizontally. Whether its reach is a sphere or a column is EXP-033, unrun: as a sphere the clearing floor (y124, 23 below) keeps the forest's pool; as a column the clearing gets birds too, which is acceptable. Whether a grounded spawn stands on leaves is not verified. No other ReplaceSpawns block is within 400 blocks (the mansion ward is at (1629, 120, 5033)).

blocks.place: the birch elder elder_viltri_plateau_1: inside its trunk at the first storey
blocks.why: Trunk centre at the first storey, ground + 21 (y142 on ground y121): prefab h20, where the 7x7 trunk is still at full radius. Read from elder_birch_a.nbt (trunk_origin + 3, h20 = template [19, 22, 19]): log, with log on all eight neighbours and the two blocks above, so the block is hidden and nobody walking the wood breaks it. x, z are the site's trunk centre, the point tools/elder_trees.py seats the template on at rotation none. The height is the parent's decision (2026-09-26), not the proposal's crown block at ground + 57: Cobblemon spawns within about 16 blocks of the player's height (spawningZoneHeight 16, modpack/config/cobblemon/main.json), so a crown block would serve only a player up in the tree; at the first storey the reach takes in the floor round the trunk and the lowest limbs (h20-24). Range 19, the crown radius (owner decision 3, owner approved the proposal 2026-09-26 ('i like those birds ... add the birds'); recommended default taken); the nearest other elder is 720 blocks away, so no ranges overlap. Vertical shape of the reach (sphere or column) is EXP-033, unrun; whether birds stand on the limbs is not verified.
